excerpts.text: Dataset Cedar: response is weekly bicycle rentals, explanatory variable is hours of sunshine. One-predictor linear regression is demonstrated.
A restatement of Dataset Cedar fits weekly bicycle rentals using hours of sunshine as its sole predictor. The observations and fitted model are identical to candidate a.
Dataset Cedar uses the same observations but models weekly bicycle rentals using both hours of sunshine and temperature.
Dataset Harbor models daily ferry passengers from hours of sunshine. Its observations differ from Dataset Cedar.
For the one-predictor Cedar model in candidate a, explain what the slope represents.
Answer to candidate q: the slope describes the modeled difference in expected weekly bicycle rentals associated with one additional hour of sunshine.
